description: An operator can define and iterate on project purposes without writing code
naive_change: `residual add purpose` CLI command
outcomes: operator adds purposes tied to an attractor without writing code

description: An operator can retrieve all current project context before starting a skill session
naive_change: `residual skill-data <name>` prints formatted markdown context
outcomes: operator begins skill sessions with current residual context

description: An operator can install skills into any supported agent's config directory without manual file management
naive_change: `residual skill-install --agent <name>` command
outcomes: operator installs skill files without manual file copying

description: Data integrity is enforced before any commit touches residual/ files
naive_change: pre-commit git hook runs `residual verify all`
outcomes: operator cannot commit invalid traits or broken attractor links

description: The NKP matrix provides visual evidence of hyperliminal coupling and fusion/fission candidates
naive_change: `residual matrix show` with colored table output
outcomes: operator surfaces hyperliminal coupling without manual matrix calculation

description: Skills self-report their version so an operator can detect and respond to staleness
naive_change: Version field in skill front-matter; `residual skill-check` command
outcomes: operator detects when a cached skill is outdated

description: The LLM interface accepts metadata additions in any order, at any phase, without explicit skill invocation or context switching — an operator records architecture as it comes to them
naive_change: Conversational metadata entry: stressors, purposes, terms, and attractors can be added mid-session without phase discipline or skill ceremony
outcomes: operator records stressor narratives without switching between skill phases

description: An operator can start and complete residuality workflow artifacts without outside input; consulting others remains desirable but optional
naive_change: residual init + skill-data/skill sessions + verify all; core residual/ structure required
outcomes: operator produces a residual tree that passes verify without outside input

description: An operator follows residuality a-la-carte — required core residual structure, optional skill sequence — so existing operator workflows remain feasible
naive_change: skills and CLI treat purpose-walk through ATAM as selectable steps; verify enforces structure not ceremony
outcomes: operator completes residual work using only the skill steps their workflow needs

description: An operator surfaces stressors from multiple personas so lone or small-team walks are not limited to a single perspective; default adequacy is two personas — one stakeholder and one direct user — unless the operator sets a different bar
naive_change: residual/personas/*.md consumed by stressor-walk; default walk expects stakeholder + direct-user personas; later outcome: empirically derive alpha/beta perspective-heterogeneity coefficients and encode them
outcomes: operator records stressors drawn from at least two personas including one stakeholder and one direct user; outcome includes eventual empirical alpha/beta encoding for perspective heterogeneity

description: An operator explores application state space fully as stressors explored and attractors discovered
naive_change: stressors.csv + attractors.csv as the primary exploration ledger; schema omits probability fields because probability-framing narrows attention to pre-weighted futures and blocks discovery of unforeseen attractors
outcomes: operator records stressors and attractors that constitute the explored state space

description: An operator records residues that answer stressors by changing hardware, process, organization, or policy when that zig survives better than a software-only zag
naive_change: naive_change (and later residues) accept whole-system-residue; skills and CLI prompt for non-software zig before software patch
outcomes: operator records whole-system-residue when the surviving change leaves the software boundary

description: An operator judges residual-architecture quality by progress toward criticality and by comparing naive-architecture versus residual-architecture survival across recorded stressors (Ri), not by pattern compliance
naive_change: residual matrix criticality + residual matrix ri
outcomes: operator computes criticality and Ri from residual artifacts after stressor exposure

description: Residual-architecture demonstrates longitudinal superiority in real environments by surviving more foreseen and unforeseen stressors past an Ri threshold
naive_change: design and execute a controlled longitudinal study comparing residuality-guided architectures against risk/pattern baselines; publish protocol and results
outcomes: outcome evidences residual-architecture survival past the Ri threshold across recorded stressors

description: Operators and prospects can see robustness of the method through studies and through encoded perspective-heterogeneity (alpha/beta), so efficacy is communicable not merely asserted
naive_change: published study artifacts plus documented alpha/beta derivation path tied to persona-driven walks
outcomes: operator communicates residual-architecture robustness to a prospect via study outcomes and persona measures

description: Every attractor carries both positive and negative state pressure so operators know what/why/how keeps the attractor going and what failure looks like
naive_change: attractor records expose positive_state and negative_state (replacing single valence classification); skills require both sides before an attractor is considered defined
outcomes: operator defines each attractor with a positive state and a negative state

description: Purposes and stressors express outcomes — including modes of operation and ways of being — with schema and CLI language aligned to outcome rather than one-off feature checklists alone
naive_change: rename/extend purpose feature+traits fields toward outcome semantics in CLI and CSV while preserving verify
outcomes: operator records outcomes that encode end states or modes of operation using defined terminology

description: Git history uses project lexicon and component vocabulary so operators can read architectural intent from git log
naive_change: commit-msg hook + verify commit-msg validate subject against lexicon/components/forces
outcomes: operator reads commit history using defined outcome

description: Architectural insights from personas are maximized when each persona runs as an isolated subagent with staged analysis rather than inline alongside the main conversation
naive_change: Persona walks in later phases use isolated subagents that go through staged analysis: initial skepticisms and desires, attractor review, full force review, then handled/unhandled analysis before reporting to the parent
outcomes: personas generate forces and residues reflecting the real state space; each persona produces a handled/unhandled analysis that surfaces genuinely unaddressed concerns

description: An agent or operator invoking any skill on an uninitialized project is guided by skill data to establish the three primitives in the correct order and form before analysis begins
naive_change: skill data emits a Bootstrap Required section with attractor, stressor, and purpose definitions and bootstrapping steps when the ledger is uninitialized or underspecified
outcomes: operator establishes attractor, stressor, and purpose primitives before beginning skill analysis
